bdrain-gphantasm-a1.name: Blastermind
bdrain-gphantasm-a1.SA1: When finished, inflicts a permanent DOOM for 30/26/22/20 seconds. DOOM is removed if the opponent TAGS OUT.

bdrain-gphantasm-d1.name: Psy Ops
bdrain-gphantasm-d1.SA1: When finished, DRAINS 20/25/30/35% BLOCKBUSTER METER from the opponent.

bdrain-gphantasm-f1.name: Claws of Death
bdrain-gphantasm-f1.SA1: When finished, grants 2 stack(s) of ENRAGE for 10/12/14/15 seconds.

bdrain-gphantasm-l1.name: Sensory Overlord
bdrain-gphantasm-l1.SA1: 35/40/45/50% of the damage dealt is regained as HEALTH.

bdrain-gphantasm-w1.name: Tinkering Terror

bdrain-hdetach-d1.name: Psy Ops

bdrain-hdetach-f1.name: Claws of Death

bdrain-hdetach-w1.name: Tinkering Terror

bdrain-msummon-w1.name: Tinkering Terror

bdrain-psyjumble-w1.name: Tinkering Terror
